name: Open Chest
description: A cracked oak chest sits crooked amid a pile of rubble. Whoever carried it this far didn't carry it any further.
descriptionVariants: A rusted lockbox is wedged under a collapsed beam, the key still in it, snapped off at the shaft.
Someone stacked their gear in a neat pile before they stopped needing it: boots, belt, an unopened pack.
chainEscalatedDescription: A chest sits in the rubble. The pry bar you carry for these has gone blunt at the tip.

name: Guardian Fight
description: A chest sits in the far corner. Beside it, a closed spiral is scratched into the wall, and something in the dark is scraping claws on the stone. The scraping stops.
descriptionVariants: Something breathes in the dark ahead, at the same slow pace whether you move or not.
Loose stone shifts under something heavy, back where the light doesn't reach. The shifting stops when you stop.
chainBuildupDescription: Claws scrape on stone in the dark corner. The sound is closer to the door than it was in the last room like this.
chainForcedDescription: It is standing in the doorway you came in through.
chainForced2Description: The scraping starts while you're still on the stairs.
chainForced3Description: Claw marks run from the corner to the foot of the stairs, worn deep, back and forth.

crossEventVariants.description: Claws scrape on stone in a dark corner, beside a closed spiral. The spiral on the artifact in your pack turns the other way.

reflection.prompt: The guardian's ashes smell of incense.
reflection.escalatedPrompt: You came down the stairs with your weapon drawn.
reflection.escalated2Prompt: Someone is cleaning their blade before the ash has settled.
reflection.escalated3Prompt: You walk through the ash on the way out without slowing.

options.curious: You pinch up some of the ash and smell it again.
options.wary: You knock the ash off your boots before going on.
options.dismissive: You kick the ash off the chest lid and open it.

name: Merchant Encounter
description: A lamp gutters over a cloth spread with goods, each with a spiral mark burned into it. A hooded figure bows.
descriptionVariants: Firelight catches on a row of small objects laid out with care, each one marked the same way. A hooded shape straightens as you approach, already reaching for the first item.
A cloth is spread flat across the stone, weighted at the corners against a draft that isn't there. The hooded figure doesn't look up until you're close enough to see the mark on every piece.

crossEventVariants.description: A lamp gutters over a cloth spread with goods, each with a spiral mark burned into it. A hooded figure bows. The cloth is the same weave as the strip grown into that wall.

returnDescription: The same hooded figure — or one just like it. The wares are new, but the bow is exactly as before.

reflection.prompt: The hooded figure never once lifted the hood, not even to count your coin.

options.curious: The hood holds your eye a moment too long.
options.wary: Your eyes stay off the hood the whole time.
options.dismissive: You came for the wares, not the man.

name: Desecrate the Altar
description: The stone altar glows with a pale red light, pulsing as if breathing. A spiral is cut into the base, closed like a knot.
descriptionVariants: A pulse of red light rises and falls along the altar's edge, patient as a held breath.
The altar's glow catches in a carved spiral at its base, sealed shut, older than the stone around it.
chainBuildupDescription: The stone altar glows with a pale red light. The pulse is faster than at the last one.
chainForcedDescription: The red light has spread across the floor to the doorway. There is no stepping around it.
chainForced2Description: The glow had reached the doorframe by the time you came in.
chainForced3Description: The spiral at the altar's base has been scored through with a blade, more than once. The cuts look like yours.

crossEventVariants.description: The stone altar glows with a pale red light. Someone in the party wipes their palms dry before going closer.

reflection.prompt: The glow is still there, faint, where your hand was.
reflection.escalatedPrompt: You stepped into the red light without testing it first.
reflection.escalated2Prompt: Your hands smell of scorched stone. You wipe them on your trousers and keep going.
reflection.escalated3Prompt: The altar goes dark behind you. Your blade has stone dust in its edge again.

options.curious: You trace the closed spiral with a finger before you leave.
options.wary: You keep your hands well away from the base on the way past.
options.dismissive: You turn your back on the glow and check the way down.

name: Trade HP for an Artifact
description: Ancient carvings on the stone pedestal ooze a dark, still-warm liquid, a spiral unwound and open at its center. The liquid creeps along every channel toward one cup and stops a finger's width short of it.
chainEscalatedDescription: Carvings on the pedestal ooze toward the cup. Someone has the knife out and the bandage ready.
chainEscalated2Description: The liquid stops a finger's width short of the cup. The palm held out over it is more scar than skin.
chainEscalated3Description: The liquid creeps toward the cup. Three of you have a scar in the same place on the left palm.

crossEventVariants.description: Ancient carvings on the stone pedestal ooze a dark, still-warm liquid, a spiral unwound and open at its center. Someone's knife is out, and someone else has a hand on their wrist.
Ancient carvings on the stone pedestal ooze a dark, still-warm liquid, a spiral unwound and open at its center. Two of you roll up a sleeve at the same time.

reflection.prompt: The cut closes before the bandage is tied. It is the length of a finger joint, neat as a ruler mark.
reflection.escalatedPrompt: The cut went where the last one did.
reflection.escalated2Prompt: The cut is the same length as the others, to the hair.
reflection.escalated3Prompt: There's a callus now where the cuts go.

options.curious: You hold the cut up to the light and measure it against a finger joint.
options.wary: You wrap the cut tight and keep the hand inside your coat.
options.dismissive: You flex the hand twice and pick up your pack.

name: Cursed Shrine
description: A statue with three eyes. One of them is open. It wasn't the same one a moment ago.

crossEventVariants.description: A statue with three eyes. One of them is open. Its lowest lid is chipped, the way stone chips under a knife point.

reflection.prompt: From the doorway, you can still see which eye is open.

options.curious: You count the shut eyes again on your way out.
options.wary: You keep the statue at the edge of your sight until the corridor bends.
options.dismissive: It's carved stone. You turn your back on it.

name: Twin Altars
description: Two stone pedestals face each other, each carved with a spiral, open at the center. A hairline crack already runs between them.

crossEventVariants.description: Two stone pedestals face each other, each carved with a spiral, open at the center. The cups set into them are dark at the bottom, the same dark as at the last altar.

reflection.prompt: Dust from the broken pedestal is still settling on your boots.

options.curious: You pocket a chip of the broken one.
options.wary: You don't go back to look at the other pedestal.
options.dismissive: You step over the pieces without looking down.

name: Ritual Circle
description: Old dried blood traces a spiral across the stone, open at one end and too deliberate to be an accident.
chainEscalatedDescription: Old dried blood traces a spiral across the stone. Your packs come off at its open end, the way they do at camp.
chainEscalated2Description: Old dried blood traces a spiral across the stone. At its open end the floor is worn smooth in two places, a pair of knees apart.
chainEscalated3Description: Old dried blood traces a spiral across the stone. The worn places at its open end fit your knees exactly.

crossEventVariants.description: Old dried blood traces a spiral across the stone, open at one end and too deliberate to be an accident. It's the same dark brown as the stain on your sleeve cuff.

reflection.prompt: The circle goes quiet. The gap at its open end is the width of a hand.
reflection.escalatedPrompt: Your knee finds the worn spot in front of the circle.
reflection.escalated2Prompt: You set the offering down in the same spot as last time, to the finger's width.
reflection.escalated3Prompt: On the way out, someone asks how many that makes. Two of you give different numbers.

options.curious: You set your hand in the gap. It fits.
options.wary: You mark the room on your map as one to avoid.
options.dismissive: You weigh the new artifact in your hand and stow it.

name: Wandering Gambling Den
description: A stranger shuffles three cups on an upturned crate, his forearms bare and unmarked. 'Give me what you have. I'll double it, or keep it for good.'

crossEventVariants.description: A stranger shuffles three cups on an upturned crate, his forearms bare and unmarked. He asks what you've already paid today, and starts shuffling before you answer.

returnDescription.won: The stranger deals a fresh hand without looking up. 'Didn't expect a winner to come back for more.'
returnDescription.lost: The stranger deals a fresh hand without looking up. 'Back for more? I like watching the same face lose twice.'
returnDescription.declined: The stranger deals a fresh hand without looking up. 'Changed your mind, or just scared?'

reflection.prompt: Behind you, the cups start clicking again.

options.curious: You'd bet he's run this game on every floor you've passed.
options.wary: You keep a hand on your purse until the clicking fades.
options.dismissive: Quick hands and a loud mouth. You've met his kind above.

name: Wandering Hermit
description: An old man sits cross-legged amid the rubble, a spiral mark scarred into his forearm. 'Put down what you want rid of. I'll name the price.'

crossEventVariants.description: An old man sits cross-legged amid the rubble, a spiral mark scarred into his forearm. His eyes are open when you arrive. He lays a clean rag on the stone beside him before you've said a word.
An old man sits cross-legged amid the rubble, a spiral mark scarred into his forearm. His eyes go to the guardian ash on your boots, then to the mark on his own arm.
An old man sits cross-legged amid the rubble, a spiral mark scarred into his forearm. He looks at your hands before your face, and keeps looking at them while you talk.

returnDescription: The old man has cleared a space on the stone in front of him. 'Trade again? I don't forget a fair deal.'
campReflectionUnawareEcho: He shuts his eyes for the trade before you've set anything down.

stanceEcho.curious: He watches you a little longer than he needs to before naming his price.
stanceEcho.wary: He names his price, then keeps his own hands where you can see them.
stanceEcho.dismissive: He shrugs and names his price before you've finished talking.

reflection.prompt: His eyes stayed shut for the whole trade. His hands never missed the coins.

options.curious: You look at the mark on his forearm until he turns the arm over.
options.wary: You keep the talk to the price and nothing else.
options.dismissive: Strange old man, but he held up his end of it.

name: Collapsed Floor
description: A section of floor has dropped away along a long crack. A weak groan echoes up from below.

crossEventVariants.description: A section of floor has dropped away along a long crack. A weak groan echoes up from below. The rope from the last one is still in your pack, frayed where it ran over the edge.
A section of floor has dropped away along a long crack. A weak groan echoes up from below. The last one like this stopped halfway through a breath.
A section of floor has dropped away along a long crack. A weak groan echoes up from below. Whoever paid at the altar is the first to kneel at the edge.
A section of floor has dropped away along a long crack. A weak groan echoes up from below. Whoever kept their hand closed at the altar stands at the edge with both hands in their sleeves.

name: Old Count
description: Someone scratched tally marks into the wall here, hundreds of them, all by the same hand, in neat rows. The last row stops mid-stroke.

crossEventVariants.description: Someone scratched tally marks into the wall here, hundreds of them, all by the same hand, in neat rows. The last row stops mid-stroke. Under it, a pack strap rotted through at the buckle.

chainEscalatedDescription: Tally marks again, hundreds, in neat rows. Your eyes go to the floor under them first, for whatever was left behind.

reflection.prompt: On the way out, you glance back once at the half-finished mark.

options.curious: You count the last full row before you go.
options.wary: You keep to the far side of the corridor, away from the wall.
options.dismissive: Somebody's nervous habit. Not yours to worry about.

name: Doubled Back
description: Footprints lead into this room and stop. None lead back out. The room is empty.

crossEventVariants.description: Footprints lead into this room and stop. None lead back out. The tread is worn down at the heel, like yours.

chainEscalatedDescription: Footprints lead into this room and stop. Your own walk straight to the spot where they end.

reflection.prompt: You check the walls for a door. The stone is solid all the way round.

options.curious: Your boot hovers over the last print, then steps around it.
options.wary: You leave the way you came, stepping in your own prints.
options.dismissive: Feet backtrack all the time. You just missed the tracks.

name: The Delay
description: Still water pools at the edge of the room, dark enough to mirror the torchlight. Your reflection catches up to you a half-second late, every time you move.

reflection.prompt: Somewhere behind you, water drips a beat after each step.

options.curious: You pass a hand over the water once more and count the delay.
options.wary: You keep your eyes forward the rest of the way down.
options.dismissive: Tired eyes. When you look back, the water is just water.

name: Waiting Supplies
description: A bundle sits wrapped and tied at the base of the wall, where someone would leave it to come back for later. The rope is knotted tight, every turn laid the same way. Dust lies thick on the knot.

crossEventVariants.description: A bundle sits wrapped and tied at the base of the wall, where someone would leave it to come back for later. The rope is knotted in a spiral, the same mark burned into the merchant's goods. Dust lies thick on it.

chainEscalatedDescription: A bundle sits at the base of the wall. Your pack is already full of bundles tied the same way.

reflection.prompt: You took half the bundle and tied the rest up again, the way you found it.

options.curious: You tie their knot again from memory, on a strap of your own.
options.wary: You eat from your own rations tonight, not theirs.
options.dismissive: You cinch your pack shut over the extra rations.

name: Vigil
description: A candle burns at the end of a dusty corridor with no footprints in it. The wax has pooled thick on the floor, but the flame is a new candle's height. A cloth lies folded beside it.
chainEscalatedDescription: A candle burns at the end of an empty corridor. The cloth folded beside it would make a good bandage.

options.curious: You hold a hand near the flame. It's warm.
options.wary: Hands in your sleeves, well clear of the flame.
options.dismissive: Wax runs strangely sometimes. You leave it to burn.

name: Broken Seal
description: A stone hatch, chained shut and mortared at the edges. Half a spiral is stamped into what's left of the lock, the other half torn away with whatever broke it open.

crossEventVariants.description: A stone hatch, chained shut and mortared at the edges. Half a spiral is stamped into what's left of the lock, the other half torn away with whatever broke it open. Chips of mortar lie on the stone beneath it, fallen inward.

A stone hatch, chained shut and mortared at the edges. Half a spiral is stamped into what's left of the lock, the other half torn away with whatever broke it open. Chips of mortar are scattered across the floor, thrown outward.

chainEscalatedDescription: A stone hatch with a torn chain. Your pack is open on the floor before the torch is set down.

reflection.prompt: You keep your torch on the open hatch until you're out of the room.

options.curious: You look for scratch marks on the inside of the hatch.
options.wary: You give the torn chain a wide berth.
options.dismissive: Old damage. Whatever happened here is long over.

name: Half a Warning
description: Someone carved this fast, and never finished it. What's left: 'saw what happened to the one who tried to carry both. I won't write what was left of them. Choose one side. Don't waver.'
chainEscalatedDescription: Words carved fast into the wall, unfinished. You read them on the way to the gear piled underneath.

reflection.prompt: The last stroke runs off the end of the word and down the wall.

options.curious: Twice you read the last word, then the blank after it.
options.wary: You read it once and walk on fast.
options.dismissive: Scratch marks on a wall. You've walked past a hundred.

name: Still Breathing
description: The walls curve like ribs here. Grown into one of them is a strip of old cloth with a mark burned into it, the same mark as on the goods you've traded for.

reflection.prompt: Outside the room, you check the seams of your own pack.

options.curious: You press a thumb against the wall. It gives, a little.
options.wary: You turn your marked goods face-in, at the bottom of the pack.
options.dismissive: Cloth rots into strange shapes. You say it aloud until it sounds true.

name: The Wanderer
description: A figure sits with their back against the wall, turning something small over in their hands, too dark to see what. 'How long's it been?' they ask, not really to you. 'Feels shorter every time I ask.'
descriptionVariants: A figure leans against the far wall, restringing a bow that has no string. 'The quiet floors,' they say. 'Watch those.'
A figure looks up as you approach, then straightens like they expected someone else. 'Not you, then,' they mutter, and sit back down facing the stairs.

crossEventVariants.description: A figure sits against the wall, turning something small over in their hands. They nod to you. You nod back and keep walking.

reflection.prompt: Whoever that was, they didn't ask your names, and you didn't offer them.

options.curious: The whole way down, you listen for an answering voice.
options.wary: You don't look back to check if they're still where you left them.
options.dismissive: One more voice talking to itself. Not your problem.

name: The One Who Stayed
description: A figure crouches at the edge of the torchlight in {{class}} gear, worn the way yours is, only longer. They look up without surprise. 'You got further than we did,' they say.

name: The Gatekeeper
description: An old man leans on a staff at the mouth of the cave, a lantern hung from its tip. The rock beside the opening is worn smooth at shoulder height, where hand after hand has steadied itself before going in. 'Most who pass leave something with me. {{toll}} coins, by custom. Keep them if you like. The way in doesn't close.'
